title: Learning Graph for Deep Learning Course
description: Interactive visualization of the learning graph showing concept dependencies for a Deep Learning course.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Graphs
Concept Dependencies
Educational Design
Deep Learning
learningObjectives: Explain how a directed edge between two nodes encodes a prerequisite relationship between course concepts
Identify the concept category represented by each node color using the sidebar legend
Trace a learning path by following arrows from foundational concepts toward final goal concepts
Analyze how toggling category checkboxes changes the visible node, edge, and orphan node counts
Locate a specific concept with the search bar and inspect the connections highlighted for that node
